GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (PanicButton.cs:16) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (PanicButton.cs:26-29) == cost 0 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(30m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new DynamicVar("Turns", 2m)` (PanicButton.cs:20-24) == both numbers, both declared. Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius -- and this card ties card/impervious for the largest block number in the pool, so Vambrace doubling it correctly matters.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` FIRST (PanicButton.cs:33) == `BlockCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._block, card=self)`, then `PowerCmd.Apply<NoBlockPower>(..., DynamicVars["Turns"].BaseValue, ...)` (34) == `PowerCmd.apply(..., NoBlockPower, self._turns, applier=ctx.player)`. The order is load-bearing -- NoBlockPower is applied AFTER the gain, so this card's own 30 block is not zeroed by it -- and is preserved. NoBlockPower is one of the eight C# `ModifyBlockMultiplicative` implementers the creature_card_cmds seam pins for gap G1 (x0), and its sim port (powers.py) is one of the five ported counterparts; the power's own behaviour is the power stream's.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Block.UpgradeValueBy(10m)` (PanicButton.cs:39) == `self._block += 10` (30 -> 40). The Turns var stays 2 when upgraded on both sides.
